{{nihongo|'''Hayasame Shrine'''|速雨神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

'''Hayasame Shrine''' (はやさめじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Hata, Tokushima|Q11390732|qid=Q11390732}}, {{ill|Tokushima (city)|Q207309|qid=Q207309}}, {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|Q160734|qid=Q160734}}.

=== History ===
The founding year is unknown. In the {{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}}, the reading of Hayasame Shrine is "hayaame." Its popular name is "Ame-no-miya," and it is said to have spiritual efficacy for praying for rain. The former bettō temple was {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Kinryū-ji}} of {{ill|Kōyasan Shingon-shū|Q3077357|qid=Q3077357}}.

In the {{ill|Heian period|Q193292|qid=Q193292}}, together with {{ill|Umorihiko Shrine|Q11449442|qid=Q11449442}} in Moritoki, Hatta-chō, it was listed as an {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Engishiki shrine|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}. In the precincts stands a {{ill|Camphora officinarum|Q158722|qid=Q158722}} designated by Tokushima City as a natural monument.
